Variants.Content: Originating from a Champagne county, the House of Brienne achieved extraordinary chivalric renown across Outremer. Its hero, John of Brienne, rose to become King of Jerusalem and was acclaimed co-Emperor of Constantinople in his eighties, routing Greek armies outside its walls, while cadet lines secured the Duchy of Athens.
Intermarrying with Capetians and Scottish royalty, Brienne commanders epitomized the international mobility and sheer martial audacity of high medieval knighthood.
Troubadours sing of John of Brienne leading charges knee-deep in Nile silt at Damietta. Where Brienne banners lead, soldiers follow with unyielding confidence.
